regression_test_before_fix.cause: Path::exists followed a dangling symlink and treated it as an available destination

checks: dangling symlink destination rejected as E_PACKAGE_OUTPUT_EXISTS
atomic no-replace publication refuses a destination created after preflight
competing destination and staged package are both preserved on publication failure
Unicode and spaces in source and destination paths
launcher succeeds with a different current working directory

limitations: release archive path validation is not covered by this change
cross-platform atomic publication is not implemented
this is package safety evidence, not independent comparative or recommendation evidence
